segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several report breakouts or an overly greasy, occlusive feel, while at least two with oily/combination skin say it works well as a night-only treatment.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are the most consistently satisfied, describing relief from tightness, flaking and winter dryness, dewy skin by morning, and repurchasing intent, though a few still find it too heavy or greasy on the face.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally like it as a night cream, noting plumper, firmer skin, though one finds the cushiony texture too rich for summer use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive-skin reviewers report mixed results: some describe healed irritation, calmed contact dermatitis or a repaired barrier, while others report burning, stinging or breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40-50 or postmenopausal frequently credit the cream with smoother texture, plumper fine lines, firmer under-eyes and improved radiance.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and firmness report visibly plumper skin, reduced fine lines and firmer under-eyes, in some cases within days; no dissenting reports on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers citing dryness or dehydration report significant relief, dewy and bouncy skin, and all-day moisture even in cold climates; a small minority say it still left their skin feeling dry, tight or sitting on top rather than absorbing.
concerns.redness: The few reviewers mentioning redness or rosacea report visible calming and diminished redness after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a compromised or damaged barrier report healing, reduced irritation and no burning despite prior sensitivity; one reviewer describes the opposite, severe burning that worsened her skin.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviews specifically discuss spots or hyperpigmentation to draw a conclusion.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, mostly oily or acne-prone, report new breakouts or cystic-feeling blemishes within days of use; one mature reviewer also reports unusual blemishes with burning, while others with oily or combination skin report no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin frequently describe the cream as too rich, greasy or occlusive for daytime, though several still use it successfully as a night-only step.

extraits.titre: Sticky, tacky, occlusive, wax like finish
extraits.texte: This is not suitable for acne prone skin, or skin that is even remotely oily. Sticky, tacky, does not dry down. Difficult to rub in, feels occlusive. Definitely not for use in summer months. I am experiencing a breakout after just two uses. The video and description say suitable for acne prone skin, feels a lot like it's geared toward marketing.

extraits.titre: Don't use if you have oily skin
extraits.texte: I have oily skin so this product just broke me out due to how oily it is. Not sure if its a formulation issue or just my oily skin having a bad reaction but ive stopped usjg it and my skin has cleared up! Oily girls stay away from this!!

I bought this cream when it released and have been using it every night since I received it. I'm in love with it. I have dry skin that gets especially dry and sensitized during the winter months. This cream feels like a thick barrier of moisture that I can apply at night and wake up to dewy, bouncy, happy skin. That being said, if you don't like a THICK and emollient moisturizer, you will probably hate this. I also see what other reviews mean about the smell (kind of plasticy) but this dissipates within a few minutes. I'm extremely scent sensitive and it's not enough to dissuade me from excitedly reaching for this product every night. I've already bought two back ups because I don't ever want to be without this cream.

extraits.titre: Feels expensive without the price tag
extraits.texte: As a postmenopausal woman over the age of 50, I have trialed numerous premium topical formulations targeting age-related skin changes. This particular cream has demonstrated noticeable improvements in my complexion, including enhanced hydration, smoother texture, and increased radiance. Its efficacy appears to surpass that of other products I've used, suggesting a well-balanced formulation that supports skin barrier function and addresses hormonal shifts associated with menopause.

I purchased this cream after reading many labels, searching for something without acrylates. Acrylates are a liquid microplastic used in many skin beauty products, and a somewhat recently discovered allergen. Before trying Naturium Multi-peptide rich cream, my skin reacted so terribly to everything I tried, that my face was red and bumpy, covered in contact dermatitis. My skin barrier was destroyed, and I was feeling hopeless. One week of using this product and my skin is almost fully healed. My skin stays moisturized all day, the cream feels rich and heavy but doesn't cause me any break outs. My skin barrier is beginning to feel healthier, and my skin looks plump and hydrated again. What worked for me won't work for everyone, but I will 100% be repurchasing this product. I really hope this never gets discontinued or reformulated! Thank you Naturium for making a product without acrylates!!

Horrific burning. My skin on my face is wrecked now, it feels like wind burn. I have never been so disappointed in a product. I even have a couple blemishes and I am in my 50's and I never get blemishes. I even had to stop my trentenoin because it hurts so bad.

I never tried the multi-peptide moisturizer, but this rich cream is amazingggg! I have oily skin but in the winter I peel and get very dry. I use this at night and sometimes in the mornings if I am not wearing makeup and have noticed a difference within a week. GET IT!
